releases.title: UI Modernization & Performance Core
releases.description: A massive architectural shift towards Shadcn standards, highly responsive exploration tools, and deep data interaction capabilities.

releases.title: Workspace Persistence & Sidebar Improvements
releases.description: Introduces connection-aware workspace persistence, a new sidebar toggle for switching between tables and saved tabs, and safety features for unsaved work.

releases.title: Architectural Improvements
releases.description: Major refactor introducing centralized API client for improved reliability and maintainability. Fixes production authentication issues.

releases.title: Pro Subscriptions, Performance & AI Chat
releases.description: A major release enabling Pro subscriptions with Stripe, McMaster-Carr style performance tuning, and a complete overhaul of the AI Chat interface.

releases.title: Pro Subscription & Error Handling
releases.description: Introduced Stripe-powered Pro subscriptions with higher AI limits, and improved system-wide error handling.

releases.title: Visualization & Query Intelligence Upgrade
releases.description: A comprehensive update improving SurrealDB query generation, introducing client-side aggregation for complex metrics, and enhancing automatic chart visualization capabilities.

releases.title: Chat Architecture & Visibility Hotfixes
releases.description: Hotfixes to improve the reliability of the new collaboration features, ensuring messages are saved correctly and the chat UI is fully accessible.

releases.title: Real-time Collaboration & Performance
releases.description: A major update introducing real-time collaboration features (Chat, Live Cursors) and significant performance optimizations for a fluid experience.

releases.title: Shared Dashboards & Excel Parsing Improvements
releases.description: Introducing a dedicated view for shared dashboards and robust improvements to Excel file parsing and user search.

releases.title: Dashboard Elements & Privacy Controls
releases.description: Major dashboard enhancements introducing rich text blocks, file attachments, and comprehensive privacy controls with a powerful markdown editor.

releases.title: AI Response Quality & Chat Formatting Improvements
releases.description: Major improvements to AI query generation, response formatting, and chat message display quality.

releases.title: AI Intelligence & UX Refinements
releases.description: Enhanced AI query generation with world knowledge, improved visualization workflows, and better data presentation.

releases.title: Collaboration & Smart Notes
releases.description: Introducing real-time collaboration features, smart annotations, and the foundation for the 'Git for Data' workflow.

releases.title: Engine Refactoring & Critical Checks
releases.description: Significant architectural improvements to the spreadsheet engine and critical bug fixes for data integrity.

releases.title: Dashboard Editor Improvements & Quick Creation
releases.description: Enhanced the dashboard editing experience with a wider modal layout, quick dashboard creation from visualizations, and improved validation.

releases.title: Advanced Dashboard Customization
releases.description: Introduced a comprehensive editor for dashboard elements featuring real-time preview, advanced color palette generation, and detailed data annotation capabilities.

releases.title: Vercel Deployment & Visualization Enhancements
releases.description: Critical deployment fixes for Vercel serverless environment and major improvements to dashboard visualization capabilities with user-controlled chart types.

releases.title: Excel Engine & Experimental Features
releases.description: Major release introducing a custom-built Excel-like spreadsheet engine with AI-powered formula generation and a comprehensive experimental features system.

releases.title: Query Tab Isolation & Bug Fixes
releases.description: Improved query tab management with SSMS-style isolation and critical bug fixes for formula handling.

releases.title: Support System & Dashboard Sharing
releases.description: Initial release with support page, feedback system, and dashboard sharing capabilities.
